news.title: 2 officers injured after chase with U-Haul ends in Cobb County; 5 detained
news.summary: Four arrested and three fugitives sought after a Cobb County police chase left an officer injured near Riverview Road SE.

news.title: Lifelong resident named new DeKalb County Fire Rescue Chief
news.summary: DeKalb County Chief Executive Officer Lorraine Cochran-Johnson appointed Melvin K. Carter as Chief of DeKalb County Fire Rescue on Wednesday.

news.title: Four sought after Hoschton vape shop is burglarized twice in 3 days
news.summary: Gwinnett County police are searching for four people wanted in connection with a repeat burglary at a Hoschton vape shop.

news.title: Canton man charged with malice murder in death of 2-year-old
news.summary: A 22-year-old man was arrested and charged with malice murder and child cruelty after a 2-year-old died in Canton. An autopsy is pending.

news.title: Woman sentenced in 2022 roommate shooting over kitchen items
news.summary: An argument over where to place kitchen items led to a 2022 shooting that has now resulted in a multi-year sentence for a Clayton County woman.

news.title: Man shot in buttocks during argument in northwest Atlanta
news.summary: A man was hospitalized after being shot in the buttocks during an early morning argument in northwest Atlanta.

news.title: Teen survives five bullets outside her DeKalb County apartment complex
news.summary: Samirya Richie, 19, survived being shot five times outside the Park at 500 apartment complex in DeKalb County.

news.title: Woman says she was grazed by gunshot inside metro Atlanta Walmart
news.summary: Police are currently investigating an incident at a Walmart in Clayton County.

news.title: Former DeKalb superintendent indicted on assault, child cruelty charges
news.summary: Former DeKalb County Superintendent Dr. Devon Horton has been indicted on new charges.

news.title: Police search for man accused of slashing tires in Atlanta
news.summary: Atlanta police are asking for the public’s help identifying a man accused of slashing the tires of two vehicles in a northwest Atlanta neighborhood.

news.title: Mom found with gunshot to head in 1999 never investigated by police; suspect appears in court nearly 30 years later
news.summary: 29-year-old Bridgett Lockhart was found in her Atlanta home.

news.title: Five suspects in custody after police chase in north Atlanta
news.summary: A Cobb County Police Department officer reportedly had an injury not considered life-threatening in the incident.

news.title: Former Georgia State football star killed in Atlanta shooting; 1 suspect in custody
news.summary: One of the the people wounded during a deadly apartment shooting in Atlanta’s Vine City neighborhood is now facing murder and armed robbery charges, according to newly obtained arrest warrants.

news.title: Former Georgia State football player identified as victim killed in Atlanta shooting
news.summary: The medical examiner's office says Demazio S. Skelton Jr. was the victim who died in a shooting in Vine City. Friends and family say he played football at GSU.
